say:3:1022030001:1.text: Whew... That gave me a scare! The gruglins have been so quiet ever since we stopped growing grapes. They're usually sneaky about it even when they wander near the village.
say:3:1022030001:1.source_cn: 呼……真是吓我一跳。明明不种葡萄后这些咕布林老实了不少...
say:3:1022030001:1.male: Whew... That gave me a scare! The gruglins have been so quiet ever since we stopped growing grapes. They're usually sneaky about it even when they wander near the village.
say:3:1022030001:1.female: Whew... That gave me a scare! The gruglins have been so quiet ever since we stopped growing grapes. They're usually sneaky about it even when they wander near the village.

say:4:1022030002:1.text: But I can't believe they're bold enough to rob us now!
say:4:1022030002:1.source_cn: 怎么突然又这么明目张胆地开始来抢劫，还直奔着粮仓……
say:4:1022030002:1.male: But I can't believe they're bold enough to rob us now!
say:4:1022030002:1.female: But I can't believe they're bold enough to rob us now!

say:5:1022030003:1.text: Do you think it's because of the snow?
say:5:1022030003:1.source_cn: 唔，会不会是因为下雪的关系啊？
say:5:1022030003:1.male: Do you think it's because of the snow?
say:5:1022030003:1.female: Do you think it's because of the snow?

say:6:1022030004:1.text: Even the village chief and the priest were caught off guard by the sudden snowfall. Maybe the gruglins were surprised too.
say:6:1022030004:1.source_cn: 你们看，村长和司铎都被突然降雪吓了一跳，说不定它们也一样呢？
say:6:1022030004:1.male: Even the village chief and the priest were caught off guard by the sudden snowfall. Maybe the gruglins were surprised too.
say:6:1022030004:1.female: Even the village chief and the priest were caught off guard by the sudden snowfall. Maybe the gruglins were surprised too.

say:7:1022030005:1.text: Oh, right! Maybe the gruglins think winter's already here, and they're trying to stock up on food.
say:7:1022030005:1.source_cn: 对哦！满满你好聪明！咕布林住在野外，之前也遇到过降温，...
say:7:1022030005:1.male: Oh, right! Maybe the gruglins think winter's already here, and they're trying to stock up on food.
say:7:1022030005:1.female: Oh, right! Maybe the gruglins think winter's already here, and they're trying to stock up on food.

say:8:1022030006:1.text: That's why they're desperate enough to raid the granary.
say:8:1022030006:1.source_cn: 所以才不管不顾地直接来袭击粮仓！
say:8:1022030006:1.male: That's why they're desperate enough to raid the granary.
say:8:1022030006:1.female: That's why they're desperate enough to raid the granary.

say:11:1022030007:1.text: We'll have to do something about this.
say:11:1022030007:1.source_cn: ……看样子，下雪的通知范围还要覆盖得更广一些了。
say:11:1022030007:1.male: We'll have to do something about this.
say:11:1022030007:1.female: We'll have to do something about this.
